definitions.explanation: A device that stores electrical energy.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{電池|でんち}に{交換|こうかん}した。
examples.english: I replaced it with a new battery.

examples.japanese: {電池|でんち}を{入|い}れてください。
スマホの{電池|でんち}が{少|すく}なくなったので、{充電|じゅうでん}した。
examples.english: The phone battery was running low, so I charged it.

examples.japanese: リモコンが{動|うご}かないのは、{電池|でんち}が{切|き}れているからだと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think the remote isn't working because the battery is dead.

notes:
{電池|でんち} means battery, a device that stores and provides electrical power.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {電池|でんち}が{切|き}れる: battery dies/runs out
- {電池|でんち}を{入|い}れる: to put in batteries
- {電池|でんち}を{交換|こうかん}する: to replace batteries
- {電池|でんち}がなくなる: battery runs out

TYPES OF BATTERIES:
- {乾電池|かんでんち}: dry cell battery (AA, AAA, etc.)
- {充電池|じゅうでんち}: rechargeable battery
- リチウム{電池|でんち}: lithium battery
- ボタン{電池|でんち}: button cell battery

RELATED:
- {充電|じゅうでん}: charging
- {充電|じゅうでん}する: to charge
- バッテリー: battery (loanword, often for car/large batteries)
